pages.text: $(italic)Formerly living; undead mechanics apply. The pack's most punishing race in daylight and its most powerful in the dark.$()$(br2)$(bold)Dark Power$(): +20% attack damage at light level 9 or lower and anywhere in the Abyss.$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$(): permanent. By day you see just as a Human does.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Shadow Strike$(): at light level 4 or lower, or in the Abyss, you also have Resistance I.$(br2)$(bold)Sunlight Weakness$(): in direct sunlight with no helmet you get Weakness and Slowness. A helmet or shade stops it, so plan around it.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Penalty$(): food gives you 20% less hunger and saturation.$(br2)$(bold)Next: keep a helmet on from your first day.$()
